description:
Job Description
 We are seeking a Full Stack .NET Developer to join a development team supporting the State of Michigan . This opportunity is open to candidates across experience levels. We are interested in both experienced developers and individuals with a strong development foundation who are looking for an opportunity to learn, grow, and gain hands-on experience.
 The development environment includes C#/.NET, Angular, SQL Server, and Azure DevOps . The team follows Agile/Scrum practices and works collaboratively to develop new functionality, resolve application issues, and support ongoing application development. 
 Responsibilities
 Develop and maintain applications using C#/.NET and Angular 
 Build and support backend application functionality
 Develop and maintain SQL Server database components, including SQL projects and declarative schemas
 Develop front-end functionality using Angular 
 Develop new application features and functionality
 Troubleshoot and resolve application bugs
 Manage assigned development work through Azure DevOps 
 Work with stakeholders to clarify requirements
 Participate in pull request (PR) and code reviews
 Collaborate with other developers to complete assigned work
 Follow established coding standards and development practices
 Participate in an Agile/Scrum development environment
 Requirements 
 Qualifications
 Knowledge of or hands-on experience with C#/.NET 
 Familiarity with Angular or modern front-end development
 Understanding of SQL and relational databases 
 Understanding of object-oriented programming and software development fundamentals
 Familiarity with source control and collaborative development practices
 Strong problem-solving and communication skills
 Ability to work collaboratively within a development team
 Willingness and ability to learn new technologies and development practices
 Experience with Azure DevOps, Agile/Scrum, SQL Server, or full-stack application development is a plus
 Professional experience, internships, academic projects, personal projects, and other demonstrated development experience will be considered
 Technology Environment
 C# | .NET | Angular | SQL Server | Azure DevOps | Git/Pull Requests | Agile/Scrum
